meta.purpose: Map each runtime stage to its entry function, inputs, real output fields (packet.data), and the contracts it participates in — each contract tagged with an enforcement status.

contractStatus.enforced: A runtime validator rejects a violation at run time (validatePipeline / validatePacketShape / validateEvent / validateUpdate / ReplayEngine.verify).
contractStatus.constructed: Invariant holds because the runtime always builds the packet that way; no independent validator re-checks it.
contractStatus.tested_only: A contract test locks the behavior, but a forged violation would not be rejected by any runtime validator.
contractStatus.specification_only: Spec requirement with no engine enforcement and no test.

contracts.statement: Knowledge packet stays evidence-scoped; no relationship/emotion/action conclusions.
contracts.evidence: runKnowledge only emits facts/signals/scenario; no validator scans for leakage.

contracts.statement: Emits pendingThreads/callbacks without passing the whole model downstream.
contracts.evidence: runContinuity selects fields into data; shape is checked by validatePacketShape (R-PKT-01) but the no-whole-model rule itself is by-construction.

contracts.statement: Interpretations are kept distinct from facts.
contracts.evidence: parity-contract R-FACT-01 locks the meaning/decision surface; no dedicated validator on the relationship packet.
parity-contract R-ESC-01 exercises the ordinary-event path; validator = none dedicated general gate.
parity-contract R-NAME-01 asserts on rendered output; no validator enforces naming inside the relationship packet.

contracts.statement: Possible meanings are separated from facts.
contracts.evidence: parity-contract R-FACT-01 locks the generic-feedback path; validator = none dedicated.

contracts.statement: Packet purity: no need/goal/action/decision/text fields in the emotion packet.
contracts.evidence: runEmotion only emits emotion fields; spec asks for an active purity scan that does not exist (validator = none dedicated).

contracts.statement: Ordinary events do not escalate emotionally.
contracts.evidence: parity-contract R-ESC-01 (pudding omission) locks it; validator = none dedicated general gate.
parity-contract R-DUAL-01 asserts the shared-substrate surface; validator = none dedicated.

contracts.statement: Dark/sexual content is not auto-escalated into crisis or intimacy.
contracts.evidence: parity-contract R-DARK-01 covers the no-over-escalation direction only; there is NO gate for the under-block direction (e.g. drug reference not explicitly blocked). See high-risk-gaps.md.

contracts.statement: Ordinary-life needs are first-class and distinct from emotions/satisfiers.
contracts.evidence: scenario fixtures exercise ordinary needs; validator = none dedicated.
runThought emits the distinct fields; validatePacketShape checks presence only (partial, shape).

contracts.statement: Blocks relationship_rupture on ordinary/generic events; selects strategy families, not wording.
contracts.evidence: parity-contract R-FACT-01 locks the block; validator = none dedicated.

contracts.statement: No final wording in the decision packet.
contracts.evidence: runDecision emits strategy families only; no text field is constructed.
validatePipeline + ExecutionBoundary reject any executed status; parity-contract R-EXEC-03 forges a violation.
validatePipeline rejects language.messageUnits > behavior.messageOrActionCount (language_message_budget_exceeded).
validatePipeline rejects rendered text under a no-surface actionType (no_surface_behavior_rendered_text).

contracts.statement: No final wording in the behavior packet.
contracts.evidence: runBehavior emits no text field.
validatePipeline rejects no_surface primarySurface with rendered text (no_surface_has_rendered_text).

contracts.statement: Public channel forces low disclosure and blocks private relationship detail.
contracts.evidence: expression build-time logic sets disclosure; parity-contract R-PRIV-02 locks it; no validatePipeline rule re-checks disclosure level.

contracts.statement: No final text/emoji in the expression packet.
contracts.evidence: runExpression emits plan fields, no rendered text.
validatePipeline rejects any other value (language_execution_boundary_violation); parity-contract R-EXEC-01 forges a claim.
validatePipeline enforces the no-surface->no_output relation.
validatePipeline budget check.

contracts.statement: Private referents are redacted on public channels.
contracts.evidence: expression-driven redactions applied at render; parity-contract R-PRIV-01 locks it; no general leak scanner in validatePipeline.

contracts.statement: Rendered output uses 豆豆, never 阿P.
contracts.evidence: parity-contract R-NAME-01 asserts on renderedText; no validator scans rendered text for banned names.

contracts.statement: No hypothesis-as-fact / global accusation in rendered text.
contracts.evidence: parity-contract R-FACT-01 locks it; validator = none dedicated.
validators.js#validateEvent rejects malformed events.
validators.js#validatePipeline runs validatePacketShape and event_id_mismatch per RUNTIME_ORDER.
validators.js#validatePipeline execution-boundary check.
validators.js#validatePipeline no_surface_* rules.
validators.js#validatePipeline budget check.
update-queue.js#validateUpdate; parity-contract R-UPD-01.
update-queue.js#validateUpdate; parity-contract R-UPD-02.
update-queue.js#validateUpdate; parity-contract R-UPD-03.

contracts.statement: canon_only updates rejected in living mode.
contracts.evidence: update-queue.js#validateUpdate; parity-contract R-CANON-01.
replay/replay.js#ReplayEngine.verify; parity-contract R-DET-01.
execution/execution-boundary.js; parity-contract R-EXEC-02.
